The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a food item which restores {{Energy||36 -}} {{Energy||48}} and applies the Steady Hand [[effects|buff]] when consumed, with higher quality versions of the dish having a larger restorative effect. It's prepared at the cooking table, though many components require the use of the [[oven]]. For the main page on preparing food, see [[cooking]].

5x gold-star Burgers are used in each instance of the Inquisitor's [[Buffet tent|Buffet Tent]] event.

==Effect==
On use, a burger will apply the steady hand buff for a duration of 2 minutes, reducing the risk of surgical errors during body part extraction. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.

==Quest==
===[[Inquisitor|Snack Time]]===
The [[Inquisitor]] asks that you build a buffet tent and sell food and drink for the witch burning. You will need to make {{Item|Burger|5|Gold}} and {{Item|A mug of beer|10|Gold}}.
